assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: final transparent game sprite atlas for Reactor Rush, six selectable characters.
Input image: approved roster reference. Preserve these exact SIX character identities, outfits, palettes, cute polished chibi proportions, strong clean dark outlines, expressive friendly faces and cel-shaded illustration style.
Primary request: transform the reference into one game-ready PNG sprite atlas. Canvas aspect ratio 3:2; arrange EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells. Each character is centered in its own cell with generous transparent separation, around 15% margin from every cell edge. Full body, upright forward three-quarter standing idle pose. Entire hair, ears, tail, backpack, hands and boots must fit inside their cell, with no clipped parts. Feet consistently near the same baseline within each row.
Cell order is mandatory: top-left Iris; top-middle Orbit; top-right Juno; bottom-left Comet; bottom-middle Lumi; bottom-right Jet.
Iris: red-orange bob haircut and bangs, round teal glasses, navy and cream spacesuit with coral red accents and coral backpack.
Orbit: tousled brown hair visibly exposed, NO HELMET, blue and white spacesuit, cream gloves and boots, purple backpack.
Juno: lavender asymmetric pixie haircut, plum and cream suit with amber yellow accents, dark backpack.
Comet: orange fox with tall ears, cream muzzle and fluffy cream-tipped orange tail, navy suit with yellow accents and cream boots.
Lumi: white fluffy yeti, bright light-blue face and hands, short dark blue horns, coral red vest/harness, dark blue backpack, dark blue toes.
Jet: dark brown skin, curly black hair, orange-lens goggles resting on forehead, red-orange and cream spacesuit, black gloves and knee pads.
Scene/backdrop: actual fully transparent alpha background throughout the empty space. No visible checkerboard. No cards, labels, names, numbers, typography, title, logo, border, separators, background, ground plane, floor shadows or floating props. Only six isolated characters. Preserve approved reference rather than redesigning. A single final asset, no variants.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: final game-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas with exactly TWO glass energy balls.
Input image 1: normal-energy-ball selection board. Only the LOWER-CENTRE option labelled D CYAN SPARK is selected. Ignore every other design on this board.
Input image 2: approved golden rare ball. Preserve this exact golden glass/energy appearance.
Primary request: reproduce the TWO approved balls as an atlas with 2 equal square cells side by side, canvas aspect ratio 2:1. Left cell: D Cyan Spark, a luminous translucent BLUE GLASS orb with dark blue interior, many distinct bright cyan star-like motes and a gentle cyan energy mist, bright cyan-blue circular glass rim and broad white glass reflections near the upper sides. Right cell: the approved GOLDEN GLASS energy orb with golden-amber transparent glass, white glass reflections near upper sides, rich turbulent golden energy wisps and luminous warm gold particles inside. Keep both spheres perfectly round and exactly the same diameter.
Composition: left orb centred at 25% canvas width and 50% canvas height; right orb centred at 75% width and 50% height. Each sphere diameter about 68% of its square cell height, leaving generous transparent margin around each to contain the glow. The two glows must not overlap.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, alpha zero outside each soft localized glow. No opaque background, no coloured panels, no black rectangles, no checkerboard, no floor, no cast shadows, no enclosing frame.
Materials: retain the clear reflective glass outer shells, energy inside, complex luminous particles and polished rendering of the references. Blue and gold colour distinction must remain unmistakable.
Avoid: all text, labels, letters, numbers, extra orbs, interface, title, borders, pedestals, UI, characters, background scenery. Only exactly two isolated energy ball sprites. Single final asset, no variations.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final 2D game arena background for Reactor Rush and its start screen; wide landscape 3:2, preferably 1536x1024.
Reference image: use ONLY the upper-right panel labelled 2 SKY LAB as the visual theme reference. All other panels must be ignored. Preserve the bright but gentle white and sky-blue floating laboratory above clouds and polished friendly game illustration style.
Primary request: create the EMPTY Sky Lab arena environment, viewed from a near-top-down camera about 75 degrees above the floor, so the playable platform reads as a broad near-circular/octagonal surface with very little perspective compression.
Composition: one large dark blue-grey circular/octagonal play platform occupies around 85% of canvas width and 84% of canvas height, centred in the frame. A broad mostly empty playable central surface fills at least 70% of the image. Dark blue-grey satin metal floor, faint subtle panel seams only, no strong distracting patterns or centre emblem. Platform perimeter has a thin gentle cyan illuminated rim and occasional subtle white rounded futuristic lab edge structures entirely outside the open playable floor. Rounded white lab forms with pale sky-blue glass accents may appear beyond the outer perimeter, small and understated. Soft bright white clouds surrounding and below the floating platform, airy pale blue sky, gentle daylight. Rounded friendly shapes and readable soft shading. Calm bright gentle palette around the edges, dark enough floor for game sprites and luminous balls to read.
Constraints: this is an EMPTY unoccupied environment. Absolutely no characters, creatures, balls, collectibles, text, title, letters, numbers, UI, buttons, labels, HUD, screens with text, logos, watermarks, lasers, hazards, platforms within the arena, central pedestal, reactor, obstacles, furniture, pillars, trees, planters, railings or protruding objects on the play surface. Do not include any gameplay objects; the game code will add them. Do not copy the menu layout from the reference. Keep the broad central surface completely clear. The arena's octagonal outer rim and background clouds are decorative environment only. Single final image, no variants. Opaque background.
